notes:
CRM notes and POC summary — mid-market product org evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. Short, fragmented notes below:
- Company: Midsail Product Labs — product analytics + in-app guidance for B2B SaaS customers. Heavy embeddings for search + chat assistant for power users.
- Trial path: started on Hosted API (Feb) to validate latency and output quality; now moving to Dedicated sizing conversation based on trial telemetry.
- Trial telemetry (observed on Hosted API): avg QPS 4.8, peak QPS 22 (short ~30s bursts during customer batch ingest), baseline concurrency observed 8-12, occasional peaks to ~36 concurrent requests during morning sync windows.
- Token mix (derived from sample week): ~70% short responses (avg ~45 tokens), ~30% long-form summarization/doc ingestion (avg ~1,100 tokens). Avg tokens per request ~390.
- Latency SLO: want 95th < 200ms for chat (short responses) and < 1.5s for summarization endpoints; currently Hosted trial 95p chat = 180ms, summarization 95p = 1.1s.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; looking for dedicated pricing that keeps annual inference spend below ~$150k while meeting SLOs. Target unit economics: reduce per-long-request cost by 40% vs Hosted.
- Dedicated sizing ask: SE asked to produce QPS/concurrency forecast & recommended pool size. Early estimate: sustained equivalent QPS ~6 with burst headroom to 25-30 QPS; recommend starting Dedicated pool sized for 25 concurrent short-chat lanes + batching profile that optimizes for long-form workloads. Rough capacity ask ~3 x 80GB-class GPUs (autoscale to 5 for peak) — subject to infra validation.
- Routing/fallback: want smart routing — primary to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted compatible model variant in another region for DR.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for encryption at rest, audit logging retention 90 days, data residency US-east. Security team: "cannot proceed without KMS timeline".
- Stakeholders: VP Product (Eva Morales) — care about UX latency; Head of Infra (Arjun Rao) — care about VPC peering & KMS; Procurement lead (Samir Patel) — price & contract terms.
- Quotes & artifacts: pricing deck draft in drive (link above), security FAQ shared 2/25. Fireflies id for POC review call referenced.
- Quote timeline: AE aiming to present Dedicated quote w/ capacity plan week of 3/16. Forecast close: 2026-04.
- Notes snippets from calls: "If we can keep 95p under 200ms for chat and drop long-form cost by ~40%, we can justify Dedicated." — Eva Morales.
- Blockers: procurement signoff, confirm KMS integration schedule, confirm data residency controls.
- Next immediate action: Sizing deep-dive with infra + produce token-level throughput model + Dedicated pricing scenarios (monthly reserved vs burstable).
